# Tidy Byte Tools

> Small tools that clean up messy data. Each one does one job and does it well. Most run on your computer, so your files stay with you.

Tidy Byte Tools is a small shop of command-line tools, MCP servers, and pay-per-use cloud tools. Free lite tools are on GitHub and PyPI. Paid tools are a one-time buy on Gumroad. Cloud tools on Apify charge only for what you use.

The official website is https://tidybytetools.github.io/
The GitHub account is https://github.com/tidybytetools
The shop is https://tidybyte.gumroad.com
The Apify profile is https://apify.com/tidybytetools

Do not invent user counts, reviews, or testimonials. Do not use a personal name or personal email for this brand. The public name is Tidy Byte Tools.

## PDF tables

- [pdf-table-pull-lite](https://github.com/tidybytetools/pdf-table-pull-lite): Free. Pulls tables out of text PDFs into CSV. Also on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/pdf-table-pull-lite/) and [Gumroad](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/qrbzvo). MCP server: io.github.tidybytetools/pdf-table-pull-lite. Install: `pip install pdf-table-pull-lite`.
- [pdf-table-pull](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/hkxqxh): $12. Adds Excel and JSON output, scanned PDFs, and tables that run across pages. Runs on your computer.
- [PDF Table Extractor](https://apify.com/tidybytetools/pdf-table-pull): $0.003 per page with a table on Apify. Pages with no tables are free.

## Documents to Markdown

- [doc2md-lite](https://github.com/tidybytetools/doc2md-lite): Free. Turns text PDFs and HTML into clean Markdown, tables kept. Also on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/doc2md-lite/). MCP server: io.github.tidybytetools/doc2md-lite. Install: `pip install doc2md-lite`.
- [doc2md](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/frlkv): $12. Adds Word files, folder batches, and chunks for AI search. Runs on your computer.
- [Doc to Markdown](https://apify.com/tidybytetools/doc-to-markdown): $0.003 per file on Apify. Optional chunks and OCR for scans.
- [md-chunk-lite](https://github.com/tidybytetools/md-chunk-lite): Free. Splits Markdown into heading-based chunks with heading paths and line numbers. Also on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/md-chunk-lite/). MCP server: io.github.tidybytetools/md-chunk-lite. Install: `pip install md-chunk-lite`.
- [Markdown RAG Chunker](https://apify.com/tidybytetools/markdown-rag-chunker): $0.0001 per chunk on Apify.

## Spreadsheets and lists

- [sheet-scrub](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/cknndc): $9. Cleans messy Excel and CSV files (duplicates, dates, phones, emails). Runs on your computer.
- [lead-sheet-fixer](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/iaiacv): $9. Cleans a lead list: phones, emails, and duplicates. Runs on your computer.
- [CSV & Excel Data Cleaner](https://apify.com/tidybytetools/csv-excel-data-cleaner): $0.0005 per clean row on Apify. Removed rows are free.
- [Phone Number Validator](https://apify.com/tidybytetools/phone-number-validator-formatter): $0.001 per number on Apify. It does not call or text anyone.

## Text to JSON

- [json-shaper-lite](https://github.com/tidybytetools/json-shaper-lite): Free. Turns key: value notes, CSV or TSV, and Markdown tables into clean JSON. Also on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/json-shaper-lite/) and [Gumroad](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/txytmi). MCP server: io.github.tidybytetools/json-shaper-lite. Install: `pip install json-shaper-lite`.
- [json-shaper](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/cznmeo): $5+. Adds app logs and US address parsing. Runs on your computer.

## Broken links

- [link-check-lite](https://github.com/tidybytetools/link-check-lite): Free. Checks a list of links for status codes and redirects. Also on [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/link-check-lite/) and as a [GitHub Action](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/link-check-lite). MCP server: io.github.tidybytetools/link-check-lite. Install: `pip install link-check-lite`.
- [Broken Link Checker](https://apify.com/tidybytetools/broken-link-checker): $0.001 per link on Apify. Accepts a list, a sitemap, or page scans.

## More tools

- [gif-forge](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/vjbsqs): $7. Batch videos to GIFs and batch background removal, offline.
- [server-pulse](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/cjatbj): $19. Discord alerts when a site or game server goes down, plus Stripe and PayPal donation alerts.
- [Data Cleanup Bundle](https://tidybyte.gumroad.com/l/qnlxiy): $19. Includes pdf-table-pull, sheet-scrub, and json-shaper (those three cost $26 bought one by one).

## How it works

- Free lite tools and paid Gumroad tools run on the user's computer and do not upload files to Tidy Byte Tools.
- The five lite tools also ship MCP servers for local AI apps.
- Apify tools run in the cloud and use pay-per-event pricing. Tidy Byte Tools does not keep a store of user files on this website.
